visual.title: Level curves and the gradient
visual.caption: The probe sits on a level curve. The gradient is perpendicular to it and points uphill, and the curves crowd where the gradient is long.

predict.question: At a point on a level curve, which way does the gradient point?
options: Straight across it, toward higher values
Nowhere: it is zero on a curve
predict.explain: The gradient is perpendicular to the level curve and points toward increasing values. A zero gradient would mean a stationary point, not the whole curve.
